title: Length of a Newly Added Word
statement: Let $N$ be a sequence of finite oracle Turing machines over the binary alphabet, and let $s$ be a natural number. If a binary word $z$ belongs to the positive set at stage $s+1$ but not to the positive set at stage $s$, then its length is the fresh length determined by $s$ and the bound stored in the stage data at stage $s$.
hypotheses_covered: $N$ is a sequence of finite oracle Turing machines over the binary alphabet
$z$ belongs to the positive set at stage $s+1$
$z$ does not belong to the positive set at stage $s$
